data.subject: YEWsletter - October  14
data.preheader: Upcoming events/ticket info, and ways to help this fall
data.intro:
Hey YEW, 

It's been a busy fall already, so take the chance to unwind at our Dance Nite on October 23! We have a great venue at the Hopewell Train Station, our own DJ Gabe will spin the tunes, and we will have a quiet space for puzzles and chatting. [Check out the flyer here](https://ecopto.org/events/2026-09-21-dance-nite/), forward it to friends and colleagues, and [get your tickets now](https://www.zeffy.com/en-US/ticketing/autumn-dance-party) to help us plan for the snacks and libations. (This event is 21+). 

Read on for more events and ways to help this month, and celebrate with us as our [petition for intentional tech](https://sites.google.com/view/intentional-tech-hvrsd/parent-petition-for-intentional-tech) approaches its 200th signature this week! If you haven't already, add your name and pass it on as we gather support for our district's commitment to face-to-face learning and advocate for  5 common-sense classroom screen-time milestones across all grade levels.
data.closing:
With autumn leaves (and dance tunes) in the air,

Karen Le Morvan, ecoPTO communications
